themes.title: AI adoption and controls
themes.consequence: Lloyds, Sainsbury's and Barclays publish different stages of AI adoption. Expanding access creates questions about workflow design, controls and value measurement
themes.intervention: Adoption, evaluation, knowledge/data preparation, security and operating-model services
themes.alternative: The enterprise may already have adequate controls and a fully resourced delivery team
themes.qualification: Named business owner, measured unresolved gap, agreed scope, mandate and procurement route

themes.title: Data and application change
themes.consequence: Aviva/Snowflake and Centrica/SAP show programmes spanning data, applications and platforms
themes.intervention: Migration assurance, integration, data quality and service transition
themes.alternative: The reported migration may be complete and follow-on work already contracted
themes.qualification: Current remaining work, delivery responsibilities, completion evidence and sourcing decision

themes.title: Cyber recovery and service assurance
themes.consequence: Rubrik UK references, CrowdStrike/Berkeley and the DWP infrastructure case illustrate distinct resilience and operating concerns
themes.intervention: Recovery testing, control integration, service accountability and managed assurance
themes.alternative: New technology may have closed the identified gap; a product announcement is not evidence of a residual problem
themes.qualification: Customer-owned risk, recovery objectives, test evidence and accountable buyer

themes.title: Provider internal transformation
themes.consequence: Computacenter's disclosed internal initiatives and TCS's customer-zero announcement show suppliers themselves are technology buyers
themes.intervention: Internal workflow/data modernisation and value assurance
themes.alternative: Work may be intentionally in-house or part of an existing strategic partnership
themes.qualification: Explicit external-sourcing intent, owner, timing and route to market

themes.title: Cloud portability and infrastructure
themes.consequence: CMA's historical findings and multicloud customer cases support questions about dependency and cost/control trade-offs
themes.intervention: Architecture/contract assessment, FinOps, workload placement and integration
themes.alternative: Switching may be uneconomic and current supplier choice rational
themes.qualification: Workload-specific economics, rights/terms, operational risk and customer decision criteria

themes.title: Industrial and frontier adoption
themes.consequence: AVEVA's industrial lifecycle and the Rolls-Royce/quantum collaboration connect engineering to newer technologies
themes.intervention: Industrial-data integration, use-case evaluation and controlled prototypes
themes.alternative: Research value may not translate into a near-term production purchase
themes.qualification: Technical readiness, validated use case, industrial sponsor and staged investment decision
